metadata.source: IAMEE SCI GW2/GW3/GW4 vetted R10 run

dimensionsGlobal.label: Economic Feasibility
dimensionsGlobal.description: Relative scale of investment and macroeconomic effort associated with the transition pathway.

indicators.name: Energy supply investment
indicators.description: Compares transition investment needs against regional or global GDP context.

dimensionsGlobal.label: Environmental Sustainability
dimensionsGlobal.description: Non-climate environmental pressures that accompany the pathway.

indicators.name: Bioenergy sustainability threshold
indicators.description: Tracks whether primary energy from biomass breaches a sustainability threshold.
indicators.regionalNote: Regional thresholds are calculated by regional land area.

indicators.name: Natural forest change
indicators.description: Captures losses or gains in natural forest cover.

dimensionsGlobal.label: Resource Use
dimensionsGlobal.description: Material and mineral demand pressures linked to low-carbon technology deployment.

indicators.name: Critical material use
indicators.description: Assesses renewable technology material requirements against availability assumptions.

dimensionsGlobal.globalNote: Global-only dimension in this SCI dashboard; R10 resource-use data are not available.

dimensionsGlobal.label: Societal Resilience
dimensionsGlobal.description: Potential stress placed on energy systems and society by the pathway.

indicators.name: Final energy demand
indicators.description: Compares final energy demand against GDP context.
indicators.regionalNote: Regional analysis uses final energy demand over GDP so values are comparable between regions.

indicators.name: Energy diversity
indicators.description: Uses primary energy diversity as a proxy for dependence on narrow supply mixes.

indicators.name: SSP and gini component
indicators.description: Represents socioeconomic inequality context where it has scenario-discriminating information.
indicators.regionalNote: Regional values calculate inequality for countries within each R10 region.

droppedIndicators.name: Electricity price
droppedIndicators.description: Dropped for this SCI run because Price|Secondary Energy|Electricity did not have sufficient coverage.

dimensionsGlobal.label: Near-term Scenario Robustness
dimensionsGlobal.description: Dependence on choices or conditions that can make near-term pathways harder to rely on.

indicators.name: Flexibility requirements
indicators.description: Captures energy-system flexibility challenges.

indicators.name: Low-carbon supply diversity
indicators.description: Assesses concentration across low-carbon energy supply options.

indicators.name: Carbon budget pressure
indicators.description: Compares regional emissions pathways against budget shares.
indicators.regionalNote: Regional carbon budgets use country-level historical emissions and GDP data with a polluter-pays approach.

indicators.name: Carbon dioxide removal by 2050
indicators.description: Captures reliance on early CDR deployment.
indicators.regionalNote: Regional analysis compares total CDR over regional land area.

dimensionsGlobal.label: Interregional Fairness
dimensionsGlobal.description: Distributional outcomes across regions in emissions and mitigation burden.

indicators.name: Between-region gini
indicators.description: Measures inequality across regional pathway outcomes.

indicators.name: Carbon budget fairness
indicators.description: Compares northern and southern regional shares of cumulative emissions.

dimensionsGlobal.globalNote: Global-only dimension; it is excluded from R10 regional radar views.

dimensionsGlobal.label: Societal Transition Rate
dimensionsGlobal.description: How rapidly societies and energy systems need to change in the pathway.

indicators.name: Final energy per capita reduction
indicators.description: Tracks the maximum decadal reduction in per-capita final energy.

indicators.name: Electrification rate
indicators.description: Tracks the maximum decadal increase in the share of final energy from electricity.

droppedIndicators.name: Dietary change
droppedIndicators.description: Dropped for this SCI run because the food-demand variables were unavailable with sufficient coverage.

normalisations.label: Within-region normalisation
normalisations.description: Each R10 region is normalised against its own scenario distribution.

normalisations.label: Across-region normalisation
normalisations.description: All R10 region-scenario rows share one normalisation range.

droppedIndicators: Dietary change in Societal Transition Rate
implementationNotes.regionalResourceNote: The resource dimension is displayed as a global score in regional views.
implementationNotes.scenarioSelection: GW2, GW3, and GW4 scenarios with SCI vetting ok, using R10 regions plus World.
implementationNotes.timeseriesInterpolation: Primary-energy and CDR time series are linearly interpolated to a 5-year grid before charting.
